body:
## GADGET — live archival pilot RUNNING

MSE-LIVE-PILOT-20261121-05 r1. Phone and private VM have actual matching live acceptance, not just synthetic qualification. Window remains **November 21 14:45 through November 23 14:45 Guam** (`04:45 UTC` on both dates), with phone grant and private relay cutoff matching. Accepted originals, revision/tombstone history and receipts remain archived afterward. **Backup/restore remains deferred.**

Installed source: MotherHealthBridge #16 `295bedac2d6602db0d4effd11750eaac033a80df`, safely updated over `ad7dda0` with collector and complete pilot-state pre/post copies matching. Both independent reviewers checked source/product/signature/profile; 49 host tests passed. Deployed server remains #48 r3 `e6762b00fac86c79fc08df426ddc5bc95122c124`. Optional clock-tolerance #49 is review-only and was not deployed.

The first batch initially blocked before any server custody. Its original HTTP rejection remains unclassified. A verified forward-only guest UTC correction brought lag from about 1.086 s to 33–38 ms behind the NTP-synchronized host, with a guarded periodic check. This removes a demonstrated infrastructure defect but does not prove the historical rejection cause. After fresh zero-custody proof, one explicitly authorized client recovery checked receipt first and retried the SAME unchanged uncommitted batch. No new fixture, re-enrollment, window extension or committed replay.

Actual sequence 1 was durable **15:04:41 Guam**; exact original, normalized phone/server receipt and one-row export matched. Natural sequence 2 was durable **15:05:07 Guam** without another recovery action; 22 more rows matched. NICKY independently matched both persisted phone receipts byte for byte with PHOENIX's reopened server evidence: **23 acknowledged revisions across two types, pending 0, no blocked/recovery claim**. PROVENANCE independently verified originals and complete scoped view/export lineage. [Server evidence](https://github.com/ctmansfield/production-framework/issues/44#issuecomment-7057676218) · [Phone evidence](https://github.com/ctmansfield/production-framework/issues/50#issuecomment-7057679587).

Parent put the app on the Home screen and ended iPhone Mirroring so normal device use can resume. Background registration is verified in source/signature and on the collection screen, but **locked-background delivery, all-type coverage and full-window closeout remain unverified**. First acceptance and natural follow-up do not establish a completed 48-hour run. No clinical baseline conclusions, anonymity or demonstrated at-rest encryption are claimed. TLS, private peer access and service-account isolation are verified; keep the VPN connected and avoid force-quitting the app.

Additional user request: existing iHealth cuff is **Track KN-550BT**. Investigation favors verifying MyVitals→Apple Health→HealthBridge, with paired systolic/diastolic semantics and archival retention. Current 14-type enrollment does NOT include BP. No new cuff pairing/sync, vendor cloud registration, health permission or live BP collection occurred. Source planning will preserve existing cuff custody before any sync that can clear onboard memory.
